ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_margin_rank_blend_sigmoid_weighted_advantage_gap
ir.intuition: Changed the margin smoothing from tanh to sigmoid-based log-sigmoid margin to reduce similarity with the failed candidate and still maintain a smooth, bounded margin. Weighted the loss by absolute advantage gap instead of max advantage to better reflect pairwise quality differences. Kept clamping of margin for numerical stability and retained weighting by optional weight. This reduces similarity while preserving theoretical soundness and alignment with configured observables.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
weight = batch.get('weight', None)
alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
margin = alpha * (lpw - lpl)
clamped_margin = clamp(margin, -10, 10)
loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(clamped_margin) * abs(adv_gap)
if weight is not None:
  loss_per_pair *= weight
final_loss = mean(loss_per_pair)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(scaled_margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(clamped_margin))
    weight_factor = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    loss = ops.mul(loss, weight_factor)
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
